bishy_owner.text: Welcome to Bishy Road. Its proper name is Bishopthorpe Road, but nobody has used that since before I was born.
York is a chocolate city. Kit Kat and Terry's Chocolate Orange were made here, and the smell used to drift across town.
The street is full of small independent shops, and they all know each other. Gossip travels faster than the post.

then.text: That is one cup each. Come back tomorrow.

else.text: Here, a cup of tea. It is on the house. Do not tell the Rowntrees.
